method.maturity: a horizon is graded only when label_date + horizon <= graded_through; to_date is always INTERIM

benchmarks.spy: SPY raw close over the same start and end dates as each ticker
benchmarks.universe: equal-weighted mean return, over the same dates, of every priced ticker on any ACTIVE mapping placement on disk today

method.price_basis: raw closes (yfinance auto_adjust=False): price return only, dividends excluded; each listing in its own currency against a USD SPY
method.hit_rate: share of values with excess > 0; for TOO_LATE, CROWDED and OVER_CROWDED a LOW hit rate is the label being right
method.call_level: equal-weighted mean across the call's graded tickers
method.freeze: calls are frozen at first sight in calls.json; a changed label or score appends a new call and never edits an old one
method.backfill: BACKFILL calls carry the label's date as it stands on disk at first run

scenarios.note: no resolution is invented; a scenario is scorable only once its own file records it resolved
